title: Anomalies as Residuals: Cauchy Displacement Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.41387v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neighbourhood-based detectors such as KNN, LOF and LUNAR remain among the most accurate methods for tabular anomaly detection, but they compare every query with the stored training set, so their inference cost and memory grow with the data and the data must be kept at deployment. We ask whether the neighbourhood geometry these detectors exploit can be compiled into a small network that scores a query with a single forward pass. We propose the Cauchy Displacement Network (CDN), which regresses each normal point onto the mean of its $k$ nearest training neighbours with a single-hidden-layer network of Cauchy activations and scores a query by the length of its predicted displacement. This displacement is an empirical mean-shift vector, whose fixed-radius population counterpart locally approximates a scaled gradient of the log density. translated_title: 异常即残差：柯西位移网络
translated_abstract: 基于邻域的检测器（如KNN、LOF和LUNAR）仍然是表格数据异常检测中最准确的方法之一，但它们需要将每个查询点与存储的训练集进行比较，因此其推理成本和内存占用会随数据量增长，且部署时必须保留原始数据。我们探讨是否可以将这些检测器所利用的邻域几何结构编译进一个小型网络，使其能通过单次前向传播对查询点进行评分。我们提出了柯西位移网络（CDN），它使用一个具有柯西激活函数的单隐层网络，将每个正常点回归到其k个最近训练邻居的均值上，并通过预测位移的长度对查询点进行评分。该位移是一个经验均值偏移向量，其固定半径的总体对应形式在局部近似于对数密度的缩放梯度。我们证明柯西单元可以精确表示结构化Student-t专家族的得分场。
tldr: 提出柯西位移网络（CDN），将KNN等邻域异常检测器所依赖的邻域几何编译为带柯西激活的单隐层小型网络，通过单次前向传播即可评分异常，无需在部署时保留训练数据。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Cauchy Displacement Network (CDN), which compiles the neighbourhood geometry of KNN-style anomaly detectors into a small single-hidden-layer network with Cauchy activations, enabling anomaly scoring with a single forward pass without storing training data at deployment.
